name: Tobari Chisa
source:
Chisa is a stoic and seemingly-cold girl that also happens to be Takahisa's childhood friend. Though she has little patience for the fooling around of the other characters (she's usually the one to tell [url=/c3270]Kanna[/url] to quiet down), she will not hesitate to take some playful jabs at the protagonist every once in a while.
By the time the story begins, Chisa is already loaded with responsibilities between being the president of Takahisa's class, a member of the archery club, on top of working at her family's minshuku (word for a private home that offers tourist lodging). As such, she is often doing her own thing and has little time to waste. Incidentally, she and Takahisa have somewhat grown apart.

[From [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/]Yuumei's review[/url].]
